channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Palo Alto Networks
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Palo Alto Networks, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: Authentication Bypass
item.description:
Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 12.1.4-h6, 11.2.4-h17, 11.1.4-h33

First step: Update Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS to the fixed version for your release line (for example 12.1.4-h6, 11.2.4-h17 or 11.1.4-h33).

Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-0257

item.title: Patch: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: Code Injection
item.description:
Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: RCE · admin required · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 12.2.4, 12.1.10-h2, 11.2.16

First step: Update Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS to the fixed version for your release line (for example 12.2.4, 12.1.10-h2 or 11.2.16).

Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-0322, CVE-2026-0307, CVE-2026-0312, CVE-2026-0313, CVE-2026-0314
